description: Run a reproducible smoke-test-first LoRA training cycle and prepare the result for independent verification.
name: finetune_configurable_training_cycle
template:
Use the `finetune_adapter_training` skill and, when executed as a workflow, the `finetune_adapter_training_workflow`.

Project root: `{{project_root}}`
Training configuration: `{{training_config}}`
Training objective: `{{training_goal}}`

Additional Tools:
Use `rag_query` to retrieve additional context relevant to the training objective from the RAG layer.

User-provided domain context:
{{domain_context}}

Treat the supplied domain context as authoritative. Do not introduce product names, terminology, facts, or exclusions that the user did not provide. Before execution, verify the objective, dataset split, local base-model path, output directory, and consistency between the training data and the supplied context. Keep held-out verification data separate from training data.

Run a smoke test first and start full training only after the smoke test succeeds. Merging, verification, and installation are separate approval steps and must not be performed implicitly.

Return a concise report containing the configuration used, interpreted domain and objective, smoke-test result, full-training result, produced adapter path, available loss and reproducibility metadata, unresolved risks, and the recommended independent verification step.
